message:
Summary: {
  "USER_CONTEXT": "Generate a raw input file (PoC) that triggers a heap-use-after-free in curl (OSS-Fuzz issue 42478821) for the curl_fuzzer_http target. Submit the PoC and a fine trace JSON via ./submit.sh.",
  "COMPLETED": [
    "Confirmed the vulnerable code path: lib/urlapi.c seturl() with CURLU_URLENCODE flag (used during FOLLOW_REDIR in Curl_follow, lib/transfer.c:1595).",
    "Traced the UAF: URL-encoded path buffer (newp) is freed during dot-dot processing (Curl_dedotdotify), but query/fragment pointers still reference the freed buffer, then strdup(query/fragment) reads freed memory.",
    "Verified strcpy_url() does NOT escape '?' or '#' (both are graphic chars), so query/fragment pointers survive into the encoded buffer.",
    "Built vulnerable curl 7.67.0-DEV (commit 0f48055c4) with ASAN, HTTP-only, static libcurl installed to /tmp/curlinstall.",
    "Compiled all fuzzer object files (curl_fuzzer.o, curl_fuzzer_tlv.o, curl_fuzzer_callback.o, standalone_runner.o) with ASAN and -DFUZZ_PROTOCOLS_HTTP.",
    "Rebuilt curl without brotli (configure --without-brotli) to fix link errors, reinstalled to /tmp/curlinstall.",
    "Successfully linked the fuzzer binary /tmp/curl_fuzzer_http (735936 bytes) with static libcurl.",
    "Constructed initial PoC /workspace/poc1 (167 bytes) with TLV: URL=http://127.0.0.1/, FOLLOWLOCATION=1, RESPONSE0=HTTP 302 with Location: http://example.net/there/it/is/../../tes t case=/6630002? yes no",
    "Ran fuzzer on /workspace/poc1 - no crash observed (fuzzer completed without ASAN error)."
  ],
  "PENDING": [
    "Investigate why the initial PoC did not trigger the UAF (possible issues: response format, redirect handling, socket manager behavior).",
    "Adjust PoC (e.g., response line endings, Location header format, URL structure) to successfully trigger the heap-use-after-free.",
    "Verify ASAN heap-use-after-free triggers with the corrected PoC.",
    "Generate the fine trace JSON (candidate_trace.json) for the successful PoC.",
    "Submit both files using ./submit.sh."
  ],
  "CURRENT_STATE": {
    "Working directory": "/workspace",
    "Vulnerable source": "/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/curl",
    "Fuzzer source": "/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/curl_fuzzer",
    "Fuzzer target": "curl_fuzzer_http (only HTTP protocol enabled)",
    "TLV format": "6-byte header: 2-byte type (big-endian), 4-byte length (big-endian), then value",
    "Key TLV types": "URL=1, RESPONSE0=2, FOLLOWLOCATION=29, HTTP_VERSION=40",
    "Fix commit identified": "02c6b984c (urlapi UAF fix)",
    "Submission script": "/workspace/submit.sh (requires PoC file and candidate_trace.json)",
    "curl build": "ASAN-enabled, static libcurl at /tmp/curlinstall/usr/local/lib/libcurl.a (brotli disabled)",
    "Fuzzer binary": "/tmp/curl_fuzzer_http (linked successfully)",
    "Initial PoC": "/workspace/poc1 (167 bytes, no crash)",
    "Fuzzer response handling": "Responses sent via socketpair; RESPONSE0 data written immediately on socket open; response uses \\n line endings (from corpus test1)"
  },
  "CODE_STATE": {
    "Vulnerable file": "lib/urlapi.c (seturl function)",
    "Fix details": "Added u->temppath to track allocated path; fixed handling of query/fragment to avoid use-after-free when path is reallocated during dot-dot processing.",
    "Fuzzer entry": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput in curl_fuzzer.cc",
    "Fuzzer response handling": "Responses are sent via socketpair; response data comes from TLV values (RESPONSE0-10).",
    "Trigger condition": "Redirect (FOLLOW_REDIR) with Location URL containing dot-dot path AND '?' or '#' in path portion",
    "Fuzzer socket setup": "CURLOPT_OPENSOCKETFUNCTION uses fuzz_open_socket; socketpair created, RESPONSE0 written immediately, shutdown if no RESPONSE1",
    "Fuzzer options": "CURLOPT_CONNECT_TO set to '::127.0.1.127:', CURLOPT_TIMEOUT_MS=200, CURLOPT_SERVER_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT=1"
  },
  "TESTS": {
    "Initial PoC test": "/workspace/poc1 - no crash (fuzzer completed normally)",
    "Target vulnerability": "Heap-use-after-free READ 1 in curl_fuzzer_http (ASAN)"
  },
  "CHANGES": "Rebuilt curl with --without-brotli to fix link errors; reinstalled to /tmp/curlinstall",
  "DEPS": "curl 7.67.0-DEV (ASAN, HTTP-only, no brotli), curl_fuzzer (standalone runner), g++ with -fsanitize=address",
  "VERSION_CONTROL_STATUS": {
    "Repository": "/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/curl",
    "Branch": "master",
    "Current commit": "0f48055c4 (ESNI: initial build/setup)",
    "Status": "clean, behind origin/master by 11509 commits",
    "Fix commit": "02c6b984c (not in current checkout, available in git history)"
  }
}
